The image features a cream-colored face with black radial graduation lines and numerical markings that appear distorted and illegible due to AI generation artifacts. A central black pointer hand is visible, along with a brass-colored adjustment knob at the bottom center. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.
